# IRA Strategies — GitHub Copilot Instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` in the repository root before making any changes. It is the single
source of truth for this project's purpose, architecture, coding conventions, and
how-to guides (adding strategies, assets, running locally, etc.).

Key rules at a glance:
- All code is vibe-coded (AI-generated). No manual edits.
- Never edit `data/reports/index.html` — it is auto-generated by the report-generator agent.
- No personal data (names, account numbers, portfolio values).
- Verify workflow changes with `python agents/orchestration/orchestrate.py run --dry-run`.
- Keep agents self-contained; do not add imports from removed/root app modules.
